meta.name: aws-solution-architect
meta.description: Design AWS architectures for startups using serverless patterns and IaC templates. Use when asked to design serverless architecture, create CloudFormation templates, optimize AWS costs, set up CI/CD pipelines, or migrate to AWS. Covers Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, ECS, Aurora, and cost optimization.

copy.tagline: 设计并部署 AWS 云架构，优化成本与性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为初创公司设计 AWS 云架构并优化成本
copy.tagline_en: Design and deploy AWS cloud architecture, optimize cost and performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing AWS cloud architecture for startups and optimizing costs

howto.what: Claude会按流程设计AWS云架构:先询问应用类型、用户规模、预算等信息,再推荐架构模式(如无服务器、三层)并生成CloudFormation/CDK/Terraform代码,同时估算月度成本、提出优化建议,并指导部署和故障排查。
howto.when: 当用户请求设计无服务器架构、生成CloudFormation等IaC模板或优化AWS成本时触发。触发后Claude会先收集应用类型、规模、预算等信息。

say.text: 帮我设计一个无服务器MVP后端,支持1000用户。
say.note: 给出架构推荐和成本估算。

say.text: 生成一个三层Web应用的CloudFormation模板。
say.note: 产出可部署模板和部署步骤。

say.text: 优化我的AWS费用,当前月支出3000美元,这是资源清单。
say.note: 返回节省建议和优先级清单。

howto.what_en: When designing AWS architectures, Claude first gathers requirements (app type, scale, budget), recommends a pattern (serverless, three-tier), generates IaC (CloudFormation/CDK/Terraform), estimates costs, and gives deployment and troubleshooting steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to design serverless AWS architecture, generate CloudFormation or other IaC templates, or optimize AWS costs. Claude then first collects app type, scale, budget, and similar requirements.

say_en.text: Design a serverless MVP backend for a mobile app with 1000 users.
say_en.note: Gives a pattern recommendation and cost estimate.

say_en.text: Generate a CloudFormation template for a three-tier web app.
say_en.note: Outputs a deployable template and deployment steps.

say_en.text: Optimize my AWS costs with $3000 monthly spend and this inventory.
